Definition: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) (relative part.); 1a) which, who; 1b) that which; 2) (conj); 2a) that (in obj clause); 2b) when; 2c) since; 2d) as; 2e) conditional if
